acquisition_method.evidence: Data were acquired in positive mode in a data-dependent manner (DDA).

cleavage_agent.evidence: After reduction and alkylation, proteins were digested with trypsin/LysC and peptide content was determined with Pierce Quantitative Colorimetric Peptide Assay kit (#23275, Thermo Scientific Pierce).

collision_energy.evidence: MS2 was switched when the ion intensity was above 5e3, with a m/z range in auto mode, a normalized HCD energy of 30%, an AGC target of 7.5e4, and a maximum injection time of 40 ms.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 was switched when the ion intensity was above 5e3, with a m/z range in auto mode, a normalized HCD energy of 30%, an AGC target of 7.5e4, and a maximum injection time of 40 ms.

instrument.evidence: A total of 1.5 µg of each sample was injected into an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nanosystem coupled to an Exploris 240 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and resolved by an Easy-Spray Pepmap RSLC 18 (2 μm, 50 cm × 75 μm) at a flow rate of 250 nL/min with a gradient of phase B (80% acetonitrile/0.1% formic acid, solvent A was 0.1% formic acid in water) from 2% to 40% in 200 min.
